operations.name: transcode_root_set
operations.summary: Register the mirror root directory the transcode ops may write into.

operations.name: transcode_status
operations.summary: Read saved-hash and dirty flags of mirrored assets, optionally discovering all /Game assets.

operations.name: transcode_export
operations.summary: Write full-fidelity raw exports of Material/MaterialFunction/MaterialInstance/Blueprint/generic assets into the mirror.

operations.name: transcode_apply
operations.summary: Apply a text-mirror plan to one asset in one editor transaction, then compile, save and re-export it.

operations.name: schema_export
operations.summary: Write the reflection schema lock (classes, properties, defaults, enums, function signatures) into the mirror.

operations.name: transcode_watch_set
operations.summary: Enable or disable automatic raw export of mirrored assets when the editor saves them.
